en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a rocky forested ravine with a cave entrance. Two men in early 20th‑century clothing stand at the mouth of the cave, one holding a walking stick, the other holding a hat. The front caption at the bottom reads that the location is in Pécs and identifies the cave. The reverse side has printed Hungarian text at the top, handwritten Hungarian message and address, an 8‑fillér Hungarian postage stamp, and a Budapest postmark dated February 20, 1930. The card is printed by Barasits, Budapest.
